entities.name: Kitt Kanto
entities.description: A leonin subway busker from the Caldaia who sings to pigeons and, through luck and nerve, wins a slot at the Red Room and a place with the Cabaretti.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: The leonin boss of the Cabaretti, who offers Kitt a warm-up slot in exchange for a Halo delivery and tests her.

entities.name: Ognis
entities.description: A fire-breathing viashino Riveteer engineer who stops a train and chases Kitt for the Halo.

entities.name: Henzie
entities.description: A devil who runs the Herculaneum Candy Shop in Park Heights and receives the Halo delivery; he is the Cabaretti agent Kitt must find.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: The leonin-led family of New Capenna who run the Vantoleone's Red Room and welcome Kitt.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A coal-capped family of engineers and viashino enforcers who dismantle rails to hunt the Halo shipment.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city plane of crime families, subways and Halo.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The smoky industrial bottom level of New Capenna that Kitt refuses to return to.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The middle level of New Capenna, between the Caldaia and Park Heights.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The glamorous top level of New Capenna.

entities.name: Lower Bassomer Station
entities.description: The subway station where Kitt sings for coins.

entities.name: Cloudponte Bridge
entities.description: The multi-tier bridge and rail line up to Park Heights on which Kitt's train is stopped.

entities.name: Herculaneum Candy Shop
entities.description: Henzie's sugary shop at Upper Bridge Plaza, the drop point for the Halo.

entities.name: The Vantoleone
entities.description: The Cabaretti theater with the Red Room, where Kitt debuts.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A magic substance of New Capenna that Kitt smuggles and that touches even the city's pigeons.

entities.name: Pigeons of New Capenna
entities.description: Birds touched by Halo and the angels' power that watch over Kitt, warn her of trouble, and carry her to safety.

events.summary: Kitt sings to the pigeons in a subway station when Jetmir stops to listen.
events.quote: this bigwig had halted right in front of her.

events.summary: Jetmir offers Kitt the warm-up slot at the Red Room tonight if she delivers a bag of Halo to a Cabaretti agent in Park Heights.
events.quote: "The warm-up slot at the Red Room tonight is yours, little songstress.

events.summary: Kitt boards a third-class train up Cloudponte Bridge, carrying Halo vials in her jacket and a gown in the bag.
events.quote: So that was how she found herself on a Cloudponte Bridge train for the first time in her entire sorry life

events.summary: The train stops and Riveteers blow up the rails, then the viashino Ognis tells the passengers she is looking for Henzie's goods.
events.quote: "There's somethin' our old pal Henzie owes us, and he knows it

events.summary: Kitt starts a brawl among the passengers and escapes through the window onto the tracks.
events.quote: Kitt jumped up onto the bench and, with a heave of her shoulders and a burst of adrenalin, popped open the window.

events.summary: Kitt flees across the Mezzio rooftops pursued by Ognis and two male viashino.
events.quote: the roof shuddered under the shocking weight of the viashino

events.summary: Cornered, Kitt drops the gown bag over the edge to fool Ognis and leaps into the chasm singing.
events.quote: Opening her hand, she let go of the bag.

events.summary: The pigeons swarm and carry Kitt up to the lowest rim of Park Heights.
events.quote: They caught her amid their hundreds of glittering wings and lifted her up and up and up

events.summary: Kitt reaches Henzie's candy shop and delivers the vials, receiving a ticket back.
Pigeons distract Riveteer lookouts and Kitt catches a train down to the Mezzio.
events.quote: A flock of pigeons circled down in a squawking mass

events.summary: Kitt arrives at the Vantoleone with six minutes to spare and gives her name as Kitt Kanto.
events.quote: "It's Kitt, if you please," she said with dignity. "Kitt Kanto."

events.summary: Kitt performs at the Red Room, spotting Ognis and the Riveteers in the audience, and pledges loyalty to the Cabaretti with a song mocking them.
events.quote: Pack those vials one by one, up to Park Heights, on the run, bye, bye, boiler

events.summary: Jetmir praises Kitt on stage and promises her a higher billing tomorrow night, having tested her.
events.quote: "We'll see Miss Kitt Kanto again tomorrow night, with a higher billing and a few more songs."

relations.note: Kitt takes his offer and delivers Halo for the Cabaretti.
relations.quote: That was how the Cabaretti worked. Once you were in the family, you were in.

relations.note: He is the boss of the Cabaretti.
relations.quote: The boss of the Cabaretti wasn't anyone's friend.

relations.note: She joins the Cabaretti's Red Room as a performer.
A viashino engineer wearing the Riveteers' coal cap.
relations.quote: A big, muscle-bound viashino wearing the coal cap of the Riveteers

relations.note: There is no love lost between the two families.
relations.quote: No love lost between them and the Riveteers, after all!

relations.note: Henzie takes delivery of Halo for the Cabaretti and gives Kitt a ticket.
They watch over her in exchange for her melodies and save her.
relations.quote: How pigeons watched over her in exchange for the melodies they craved.

relations.note: Henzie's shop is on the Heights.
relations.quote: The stained-glass and beetle-shell sugar candy shop sat two blocks away from the Crossponte Bridge Station
